title: Brilliant Evermore
survival_class: SURVIVAL CLASS 3 (Resources 2/5; Exit 5/5 Dead End; Environment 2/5; Entities 2/5)
physical_identity: Polluted, smoggy Earth-like landscape of plastic grasslands, bare hills and asphalt highways with raised luxury mansions, acidic seas and a looping radio station.
scale_topology: Vast outdoor level with three biomes plus oceans; raised buildings; abandoned mines in hills.
lighting_sound: 24 h day/night, burning sun, UV up to 20, smog; radios up to 110 dB; screaming broadcast during 2019.

entities.name: RoboPets
entities.behavior: Hostile robots in ~10% of mansions; cannot open doors; need recharge

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: RoboPets (no biological life)
items_communities: Former M.E.G. Outpost warehouse (abandoned, all dead)

entrances.method: Open area with a ship above
entrances.quote: Finding an open area with a ship above in Level 43 .
Opening a corroded bluish metal on Level 84 .

entrances.method: Door labelled Dust south of Ghoul Town
entrances.quote: Opening a door labelled “Dust” south of Ghoul Town in Level 99 .

exits.method: Vehicle noclip while driving toward palace (Amelia, 2024)
exits.quote: she and her vehicle noclipped into Level 64 .

signature_mechanic: Dead-end polluted Earth parody: sheltered luxury mansions, Station Number One radio, RoboPets in some mansions, exit only by unintentional noclip.
verticality: Raised buildings; hills with mines and deep tunnels; no towers stated.
content_warnings: Killing of a person by narrator
conflicts_notes: B.N.T.G. claims Level 85 was an illusion of The End; Yusuf had no evidence. Military base text redacted. Warpberries stated not to work.
